messages.subject: adding two grouped variables in lavaan syntax
parts:
Dear ALL,
I would appreciate it if you could help me regarding the following question?
how I can report analyses for two grouped variable in lavaan,
Is the below syntax correct?
I want to report the results not only for different genders, but also among different age groups.

Model: a cross-lagged model with three timepoints
Model8.fit<- sem(Model8,data = X8J21, fixed.x =FALSE, conditional.x = FALSE,missing="pairwise",group =C("Sex0","Groupage0"),ordered=c("PA0","PA1","PA2"))

Best regards,
Parisa Ganjeh

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: adding two grouped variables in lavaan syntax
parts:
Parisa

If you are interested in the interaction between groups, then you should create a  new grouping variable that represents all possible groups combinations. If you are interested of one group variable at a time, then you should do these as separate analayis
